fn mulstep u32 u32 -> u32

end

fn tenpow u32 -> u32
r fold mulstep p0 1
ret r
end

fn digitstep u32 u32 u32 -> u32

end

fn morecheck u32 u32 u32 -> bool
p call tenpow p0
fits lt p2 p

end

n loop morecheck digitstep 10 1 p0
ret n
end

fn putdigit io u32 u32 u32 -> io

p call tenpow pos
q div p2 p
d rem q 10
ch add d 48
t write p0 2
u write t 1

ret v
end

end

end

f write e 1

fn r_int io u32 u32 -> io
q div p2 100
r call putnum p0 q
ret r
end

fn r_one io u32 u32 -> io
q div p2 100
a call putnum p0 q
b write a 2
dot text "."
c puts b dot
tn div p2 10
td rem tn 10
ch add td 48
d write c 2
e write d 1
f write e ch
ret f
end

fn r_two io u32 u32 -> io
r call putfix p0 p2
ret r
end

fn putratio io u32 -> io

mid ge p1 1000
nb select big 1 0
nm0 select mid 1 0
nm select big 0 nm0
rest add nb nm
ns sub 1 rest
a fold r_int nb p0 p1

ret c
end
